design_description: A bold modern design built around a sweeping distressed brushstroke that cuts diagonally across the jersey, creating strong movement and visual impact. Deep forest green and warm sand tones are contrasted through the large paint effect, while subtle diagonal micro-textures and fine gold speckling add depth across the background. Gold piping along the side panels, together with gold logos, numbering, and trim, reinforces the premium aesthetic and unifies the color palette. The asymmetrical composition keeps the brushstroke as the focal point while preserving clear space for the crest, number, and sponsor elements. Overall, the jersey feels dynamic, elegant, and contemporary, blending rugged artistic textures with refined premium detailing.
